text:
During multiple sprint exercise, the adenine nucleotide breakdown products that rise in the blood are ammonia (from AMP deamination to IMP), hypoxanthine, and uric acid. Inosine and xanthine also rise, though less markedly. These come from ADP being converted to AMP (myokinase reaction), then to IMP, inosine, hypoxanthine, xanthine and finally uric acid. The muscle releases IMP-derived hypoxanthine and ammonia into the blood, and plasma uric acid keeps rising for some time after the exercise.

CONFIDENCE: 80
